python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/housing_dataset.csv')

# 1. Price distribution histogram
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.histplot(df['price'], bins=30, kde=True, color='blue')
plt.title('Distribution of House Prices')
plt.xlabel('Price')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.savefig('price_distribution.png')
plt.close()

# 2. Area vs Price scatter plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.scatterplot(x='area', y='price', data=df)
plt.title('House Price vs Area')
plt.xlabel('Area (sqft)')
plt.ylabel('Price')
plt.savefig('area_vs_price.png')
plt.close()

# 3. Bar chart of average price by furnishing status
avg_price_furnishing = df.groupby('furnishingstatus')['price'].mean().reset_index()
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x='furnishingstatus', y='price', data=avg_price_furnishing, palette='viridis')
plt.title('Average House Price by Furnishing Status')
plt.xlabel('Furnishing Status')
plt.ylabel('Average Price')
plt.savefig('average_price_by_furnishing.png')
plt.close()

print('Charts saved successfully.')
"

python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/housing_dataset.csv')

# 1. Price distribution histogram
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.hist(df['price'], bins=30, color='blue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
plt.title('Distribution of House Prices')
plt.xlabel('Price')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)
plt.savefig('price_distribution.png')
plt.close()

# 2. Area vs Price scatter plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.scatter(df['area'], df['price'], alpha=0.6, edgecolors='w', s=50)
plt.title('House Price vs Area')
plt.xlabel('Area (sqft)')
plt.ylabel('Price')
plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)
plt.savefig('area_vs_price.png')
plt.close()

# 3. Bar chart of average price by furnishing status
avg_price_furnishing = df.groupby('furnishingstatus')['price'].mean().reset_index()
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.bar(avg_price_furnishing['furnishingstatus'], avg_price_furnishing['price'], color='skyblue')
plt.title('Average House Price by Furnishing Status')
plt.xlabel('Furnishing Status')
plt.ylabel('Average Price')
plt.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)
plt.savefig('average_price_by_furnishing.png')
plt.close()

print('Charts saved successfully.')
"
